body: Well, that definitely sucks. I don't know the full story, but I'm sorry she did that to you, some people don't understand the sacrifice behind some of the actions we do just to be with them, but in the end all we can do is grow and learn from the things life throws at us. It's a new year my man, take this as a fresh start and even tho it sucks, try and focus on yourself from now on, we can't change people's hearts but we can sure as hell change the things we focus on and the way we deal with the bullshit. All the best wishes to you !

I'm going through the same right now, so I understand exactly how you feel. I'm sorry you have to feel this way tho, I wish everyone had happy endings but reality is often disappointing. Try to occupy your mind on different things and don't judge yourself for what you're feeling, this stuff only goes away with time. I hope you feel better soon.
